name: Play-first: sofa and ottoman tucked by the stairs facing the window, the biggest play floor on the STOENSE
notes:
Alternative, play-first: No TV (F-65); the bottom side is open to the kitchen and dining area, so its 30-inch walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42): nothing stands against it or hangs on it, and it is the route from the stairs to the kitchen and dining room.
The living group tucks into the room's left-hand side by the stairs: the KIVIK faces the window with its back to the open side, and the soft KIVIK ottoman stands in for the coffee table and seats the fourth person. Everything in front of and east of the sofa is open play floor on the TIOKRONA and the 67 x 94" sage STOENSE side by side, one continuous floor from the walkway along the stairs to the toy wall (the floor east of the sofa is 111" wide, 75" before), with the SMÅSTAD reading bench and a KALLAX 2x2 of toy drawers on the upper section, the low BESTÅ toy cabinet and its FLISAT book display in the 50" left of the open side's walkway, the LÄTT table, and Maddie's POÄNG facing her books.
sofa-1 KIVIK, rot 180, x 58-147.75, y 102-139.375: its front 96" from the heater face (F-33, 12" needed); its back 3.6" short of the open side's 30" walkway (F-39, F-42); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
ottoman-1 KIVIK ottoman with storage, x 85.188-120.562, y 58.5-86: 16" in front of the sofa (F-39), 52.5" from the heater face (F-33); soft, no corners, machine-washable cover; drinks go on a tray or the side table.
side-table-1 LACK side table with lamp-1 STORSEGEL at the sofa's left arm, x 36.375-58, y 117.75-139.375, beside the walkway along the stairs; floor-lamp-2 TÅGARP at the right arm (x 148.75-157.75, y 128-137); plant-1 FEJKA by the walkway (x 38-47, y 100-109).
rug-1 TIOKRONA 118 x 94", x 38-156, y 46-140: under the sofa's front, the ottoman and the open floor in front of them, which is play floor too.
rug-4 STOENSE 67 x 94" pale green, x 156-223, y 42-136: the play floor, butting onto the TIOKRONA.
toy-bench-1 SMÅSTAD reading bench in the window corner, right-upper wall x 240.5-261, y 18-53.375: 12" from the heater face (F-33); its boxes keep 24" (F-32); wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST above it and the LÖVA canopy over it (an extra, 12"+ off the heater face); art-2 RÖDALM on the window wall beside it. Check the heater's surface temperature before she reads there.
bookcase-2 KALLAX 2x2 with four KALLAX drawer inserts (eight toy drawers), right-upper wall x 245.625-261, y 62.875-93: anchor-required (F-21, 30 1/8"); 24" clear in front (F-32).
toy-cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors 47 1/4 x 16 1/2 x 15", standing on the floor against the right-lower wall, x 259-275.5, y 94.75-142 (F-63): push-open Lappviken doors at her height with DRÖNA boxes inside, no glass, 15" tall; 24" clear in front (F-32); 1" short of the walkway (F-42). book-display-1 FLISAT stands on it (top layer); art-1 PJÄTTERYD above.
kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 172-196.75, y 92-110.875, on the STOENSE: well outside the KALLAX's 24" (F-32: its zone starts at x 221.6) and the BESTÅ's.
kid-chair-1 POÄNG kid's armchair facing east to her books, x 212-234, y 124-142.5: 1" outside the BESTÅ's 24" (F-32), 0.5" short of the walkway (F-42), 15" right of the LÄTT.
Right side (F-61): the right-lower wall carries the BESTÅ (47 1/4" of the 50" left of the walkway), the 93" right-upper wall the SMÅSTAD and the KALLAX 2x2.
Not placed: the TV and every TV unit (F-65); the 70 7/8" BESTÅ drawer combination (it would reach into the open side's walkway); the PERJOHAN bench that backed the sofa (the sofa's back is on the open side now); the LACK coffee table and console (the ottoman replaces the table; a console would stand in the walkway); the POÄNG armchair (the ottoman is the fourth seat); the chaise sofa (c); TROFAST (a, b); KALLAX 2x4 (c); LEN and VALLABY rugs (a, b, c); the BISSA and hooks (the bottom wall is open); the LAUTERS (e).
Stairs: they run outside the left wall, beyond the measured 261" (F-40; Andrew, 2026-10-24: the stairs add to the room, they are not cut from it), so the floor is whole up to that wall. Both 36" landings at the ends of the stairs (x 0-36, y 0-36 and y 137-173) stay clear, and the 36" strip along the stairs between them (x 0-36) is the walkway that joins them: the bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the strip and the route along the window (F-30). Nothing stands against the stair side, whose edge (wall, half wall or railing) is unknown, so Maddie has nothing there to climb (F-21); which end people step off is unknown too (assumed-position:stairs).
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there and nothing stands under it (F-38).
Entry: the old shoe cabinet, hooks and mirror hung on the bottom wall, which is open; the hooks are gone, and the LILJETRÄD mirror hangs on the window wall above the top landing.
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; storage over 27" is anchored.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, KALLAX insert with 2 drawers x4, DRÖNA boxes x3 (inside the BESTÅ), LÖVA canopy x1.
